Messages.Author: MATTHEW C. JOHNSON
Messages.Body:
I would like to know if someone can escape my Trap card with just a single
press to end combat? The Trap says 'combat automatically has a press', is
that only one press or always has a press to counter any attempts to escape?

M Johnson

Messages.Author: Larry Harriman
Messages.Body:
MATTHEW C. JOHNSON (mcj...@silver.sdsmt.edu) wrote:
: I would like to know if someone can escape my Trap card with just a single

: press to end combat? The Trap says 'combat automatically has a press', is
: that only one press or always has a press to counter any attempts to escape?

: M Johnson

Each round of combat has a press to continue combat(with some
unrelated conditions). If someone plays a press to end, combat's over before
you have another round to get a press in. If you cancel their press to end,
then you trap still hangs around for future fun :).

Larrx...

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:



Yes to the first.
Each round automatically has one press to continue combat.
A single, unaswered press to end combat will end the process,
although a second press to continue may be played (leading
to three more rounds, unless more cards are played).

>M Johnson

Messages.Author: Kendrick Gillett
Messages.Body:


Every round has a press which may be cancelled with a press to end to
escape the trap ( up to the three round limit after the last card has
been played). However, you may press to continue combat to cancel the
press to end combat, causing the trap to continue.
